reference_class.name: Ramble demo marketplace, Oct 20 to Nov 4 2026: the 36 units with a recorded actual (summed likely estimate 68.75 days)

units.title: Accounts, domain, GitHub App, Hobby caps and secrets, from preflight.md
units.notes: Dave walks preflight.md after the agent dry-runs it. Hobby caps: 100 deploys a day, 100 GB bandwidth a month, 6,000 build minutes a month, 1 concurrent build.

units.title: Design: a Figma file and a Claude Design artifact of the same tokens, components and six layouts, compared
units.notes: Added 2026-11-06 at Dave's request after the range review. Two renderings of one design: a Figma file driven through the Figma MCP, and an interactive Claude Design artifact Dave can try options in. Dave compares, picks or merges, and signs off one source of truth for tokens. Shell and every page depend on it. Timing is measured, not promised: Dave logs start and stop times in docs/plan/time-log.csv.

units.title: Prove Keystatic GitHub mode on the current Next.js App Router release
units.notes: Runs beside preflight; needs the GitHub App from preflight only for the GitHub-mode half, so start with local mode.

units.title: Next.js app with strict TS, lint, format, Knip, Vitest, Playwright smoke, CI and Vercel link
units.notes: Human-led: Dave decides, /senior types. Estimate is Dave's attention, not elapsed typing. Pinned human-led although off the path once the design unit became the longest opener: the toolchain and CI are the foundation every agent unit builds on.

units.title: Agent identity and merge desk: GitHub App, rulesets with required checks, agent-git, post-check, scope-manifest, revert
units.notes: Added 2026-11-06: Dave wants the portfolio run like any project, on the Ramble model. Ported from ramble/scripts/merge-desk with the integration tier removed (one tier, main only). Human-led: Dave creates the App and the rulesets, /senior ports the scripts. Every agent fan-out unit depends on it.

units.title: Layout, nav, footer, tokens, primitives, metadata defaults, a11y skeleton
units.notes: Agent fan-out. Round one delivers tokens.css and the primitives matching the Figma file; Dave checks them against the design before the layout is built. Design calls were made in figma-design. Routed to agent fan-out although on the path: uncertainty 1, and the design is already settled in Figma.
